name: The Blackjacks
caption: A Canadian tag team that recurred across the promotion's April-May 1997 run, going the distance in a non-title match against Stone Cold Paul Smith and the Taskmistress, a Tag Team Championship match against the American Women, and a Four Corners tag match they won at Star Wars: In Your Hutt.

tenures.source: RawNitro from Wrigley Field Part 2, 1 Apr 1997 (msg_id U6EZcxNfULYJ); Spring Spampede Part 2, 6 Apr 1997 (msg_id p-GM83qupwMJ); Star Wars: In Your Hutt Part 1, 11 May 1997 (msg_id PMaJzeoFGR0J).

name: The Perfect Canadians
caption: The Maritimer and Deadshot's Tag Team Championship partnership, three-time champions by Spamboree 1997.

tenures.note: Named on-air by both members and by the ring announcer; regains the Tag Team Championship from the Taskmistress and Powrhug Kare in a no-DQ, no-countout main event, its members' third reign as a pair.
tenures.source: Wins the Tag Team Championship in the Spamboree hour three main event (msg_id sUTQRDFnh8gJ), 19 May 1997; defended (unsuccessfully verified) into June per the fed's own preview text naming a challenge from the Boyz In The Band.

name: Perfection Personified
caption: Blakenstein and en4cer's JWO tag partnership, self-declared the "one perfect tag team" and eventual Tag Team Champions.

tenures.note: Self-named on-air by both members at Spamboree, declaring an intent to become Tag Team Champions. Confirmed as the new champions only via a later broadcast's own recap; the title-change document itself is not held in these holdings.
tenures.source: Declared as JWO's new tag pairing by Jack Epstein, Spamboree hour three (msg_id sUTQRDFnh8gJ), 19 May 1997; billed as "the NEW Tag Team Champs" in the RawNitro from Jurassic Park broadcast's own recap and preview text (msg_ids Z3eKW9A1r6cJ, X7gwcZbnvwAJ), 23 Jun 1997.

name: New Demolition
caption: A masked run-in pairing self-named after the real WWF's Demolition, active through May and June 1997.

identity.note: Shares a name with an unrelated fed's own unit; no evidence connects the two.

tenures.note: Self-named backstage; runs in on undercard and midcard matches without wrestling a match of its own in this pass's own read.
tenures.source: Run-ins across all four Spamboree segments and RawNitro 5/19 hour two (msg_ids szJpgaBsL08J, mqmc15oJ2PEJ, sUTQRDFnh8gJ, OD8GwRWaHM4J), 19 May 1997; named again in the RawNitro Is War from Indianapolis Speedway broadcast's own recap (msg_id aVbPhO5U_2gJ), 26 May 1997.

name: The Power Macs
caption: A VWO tag team of Conn MacKintosh and a member whose real name is redacted under the privacy rule, fighting the New Smell Of Fear to a double countout.

tenures.source: Billed by name entering against the New Smell Of Fear (Bairman & Gern Blanston), RawNitro Is War from Denver (msg_id f-pgaT0b3pcJ), 28 Jul 1997; a former Tag Team Championship-holding team per the same broadcast's own commentary.

name: The Four Horsemen
caption: A stable reformed in a ring-invasion angle at Crash Of The Vampians III, going on to win the RSPWWCW Tag Team Championship and headline an eight-man tag match previewing the wing's own War Games supercard.

identity.note: A different fantasy-wrestling stable reusing the name of the famous real-wrestling stable; nothing links the two beyond the shared name.

tenures.source: Reformed in a ring-invasion angle at Crash Of The Vampians III, 14 September 1998; two of its members win the RSPWWCW Tag Team Championship at Rawnitro and Thunder from Portland, 21 September 1998; the full four-man group defeats a rival eight-man team at Rawnitro and Thunder from Chicago, 10 October 1998.

name: Stone Cold Homos
caption: The tag team that won the RSPWWCW Tag Team Championship at Crackdown from Florida in 2001 and carried it into the Regal Rumble.

tenures.source: Wins the RSPWWCW Tag Team Championship from the Mormon Godfather and Senator John Proulx at Crackdown from Florida, 7 March 2001; enters the Regal Rumble, 29 June 2001, as reigning champions.

name: The Right To Flame
caption: A two-man stable formed at Crackdown from Florida in 2001, its interference costing Liz Michael both a tag match and, months later, the World Heavyweight Championship.

tenures.source: Formed on-air at Crackdown from Florida, 7 March 2001; interferes in Tehawk's European Championship match and Liz Michael's World Heavyweight Championship match at the Regal Rumble, 29 June 2001.
